summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py (with _loop/_thread_id state set and cleared in run_async's finally) and added tests/test_concurrency.py with 10 tests; all 10 pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at this repo's src. The wider suite (excluding snapshot, cli, devtools) has the same 68 failures with and without the change, caused by the venv lacking pytest-asyncio. The venv's editable textual install points to a different checkout, so runs need PYTHONPATH=<repo>/src. Nothing is committed.
